Your request has been sent successfully. We will get back to you as soon as possible. Cancel Get Expert Advice Frequently asked questions Do I need a credit card to start the free trial? No. You can start your free trial without providing any credit card or payment information. This gives you the opportunity to test Web Scraper Cloud on your own websites and workflows before deciding whether a paid plan is right for you. Can Web Scraper Cloud scrape my website? Most likely, but the best way to find out is to try it. Web Scraper Cloud works with public websites, including e-commerce stores, marketplaces, job boards, directories, and real estate websites. It does not support data extraction from social media platforms, including LinkedIn. Every website is built differently, and some use advanced anti-bot protection or other technical measures that may affect compatibility. That's why we offer a free trial, so you can test your target website before subscribing. Can Web Scraper Cloud scrape JavaScript websites? Yes. Web Scraper Cloud can scrape many modern websites that rely on JavaScript to load content. It uses browser automation to load pages before extracting data, making it compatible with websites built using frameworks like React, Vue, Angular, and other dynamic front-end technologies. As with any web scraping tool, compatibility depends on how the specific website is built. Can Web Scraper Cloud scrape websites protected by Cloudflare Turnstile? Many websites protected by Cloudflare Turnstile can be scraped successfully, but there is no universal solution. Every website configures its bot protection differently, and Cloudflare continuously evolves its detection methods. In most cases, Web Scraper Cloud combined with our built-in proxy network can scrape these websites successfully, but compatibility depends on the specific website. The easiest way to find out is to test your target website during the free trial. Do I need to buy or manage my own proxies? No. Web Scraper Cloud includes a built-in proxy network, so you don't need to purchase or configure third-party proxies. Choose the country you want requests to originate from, and we'll handle proxy management automatically to help improve scraping reliability. What is a URL credit? A URL credit is used each time Web Scraper Cloud loads a webpage. It doesn't matter whether you extract one record or one thousand records from that page. Loading the page counts as a single URL credit. For example, scraping 100 pages uses 100 URL credits, while extracting hundreds of products from one page still uses just one. What happens if I run out of URL credits? If you reach your monthly URL credit limit, you can upgrade to a plan with more credits or wait until your credits renew at the beginning of your next billing cycle. This gives you the flexibility to choose the option that best fits your scraping workload. Can I upgrade or downgrade my subscription? Yes. You can upgrade your subscription at any time if your scraping needs grow. If you choose to downgrade, the change will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle, so you'll keep access to your current plan until then. Can I cancel my subscription at any time? Yes. You can cancel your subscription whenever you like. Your subscription will remain active until the end of your current billing period, and you won't be charged again unless you decide to renew. Is web scraping legal? Web scraping is legal in many situations, but the rules depend on factors such as the type of data being collected, how it's used, the website's terms of service, and the laws that apply in your jurisdiction. You're responsible for ensuring your scraping activities comply with applicable laws and the websites you access. What if I need help getting started? We're happy to help. Whether you're building your first scraper, configuring scheduled scraping jobs, troubleshooting a specific website, or optimizing an existing scraper, our support team is available to help you get your project running successfully. Is Web Scraper Cloud suitable for businesses? Yes. Web Scraper Cloud is designed for businesses that rely on web data. Whether you're monitoring competitors, collecting market intelligence, enriching internal databases, tracking prices, or powering AI workflows, the platform provides reliable browser automation, scheduling, proxies, APIs, and scalable infrastructure for production workloads. Why choose Web Scraper Cloud instead of building my own scraper? Building and maintaining your own scraper takes time, especially when websites change or require browser automation, scheduling, proxies, retries, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. Web Scraper Cloud provides these capabilities out of the box, allowing you to spend less time maintaining infrastructure and more time working with the data you collect. A URL credit is used each time Web Scraper Cloud loads a webpage. It doesn't matter whether you extract one record or one thousand records from that page. Loading the page counts as a single URL credit. For example, scraping 100 pages uses 100 URL credits, while extracting hundreds of products from one page still uses just one.

If you reach your monthly URL credit limit, you can upgrade to a plan with more credits or wait until your credits renew at the beginning of your next billing cycle. This gives you the flexibility to choose the option that best fits your scraping workload.
